acceptance: In specification-update mode with no specification path, `propose-tracker-updates` finds the repository root's `use-case-index.csv` row by use case name, slug or derived ID and reads the file its `spec` names; a developer-given path wins; with no row, a blank `spec` or a missing file it asks once for a path and otherwise reports "no specification", and it never falls back to the inventory's source location for a specification. (B01)
The `record_key` note in the skill states the real lookup rule, and the folder, example and contract copy still pass the review checklist with no Craft term. (B10)
